title: Edge workers pinned at 100% CPU
ticket: INC-2207, 13:42 UTC. Minutes after this morning's managed-rules release, every edge worker is pinned at 100% CPU and customers get 502s. No code shipped, only rules. The new rule is in simulate mode, so it supposedly can't affect traffic.
explanation: The new xss-302 pattern ends in .*(?:.*=.*), nested greedy wildcards. When the text has no '=' after the prefix, the engine tries every way to split it between the wildcards, from every starting position. In Node, a body of 800 digits takes over 40 seconds to test against it. Simulate mode still runs the regex; it only changes what happens on a match.

source.label: Cloudflare: Details of the Cloudflare outage on July 2, 2019
